name: Juana Díaz (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above for silver and yellow below for gold, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in natural colours.
history: Juana Díaz is a town and municipality on the southern coast of Puerto Rico, the Ciudad del Jacaguas after its river.

features.role: municipal arms reading CIUDAD DEL JACAGUAS
